metric_definition: Mean absolute RGB error against known ideal colors in four inside-corner regions. This verifies a spatial color-cast fixture, not quality on user photos.
browser_checks: Automatic is selected for a new mask and manual softness is hidden
Manual mode and 19px softness survive applying and reopening the mask
Automatic mode and disabled color matching submit the correct payload
Saved automatic recipes restore automatic mode; older recipes without blend_mode restore manual mode
Portrait 390x844 and landscape 844x390 controls fit without horizontal overflow
Landscape expanded controls and Apply remain reachable by footer scrolling
Corrected synthetic result opens in the full-screen viewer
No browser console errors or warnings
limitations: Not tested on the specific user photo; individual model outputs can still have geometry or lighting mismatches.
The brush must still cover the complete object, shadows and a little surrounding background.
Unreliable local context is skipped; automatic blending keeps the allowed area inside the original mask.
A physical phone was not tested.
